newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Westfield reorganises board and management.
newsitem.headline: Westfield reorganises board and management.

text.p: Property group Westfield Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday said it had reorganised its management and board structure to give chairman and founder Frank Lowy more time for strategic work on the group's three key units.
The company said it had appointed Fred Hilmer to the new position of deputy chairman and had named three managing directors for each unit.
The company said David Lowy would be managing director responsible for corporate and international matters, including group planning and the Asian and new ventures operations of Westfield Holdings.
Peter Lowy would be managing director responsible for the group's U.S. interests including the Westfield America Trust.
Steven Lowy would be managing director responsible for the Australian shopping centre business, the Westfield Trust and associated support services.

"The growth of the Westfield group requires Mr Lowy to spend more time on strategic leadership, growth and governance of the four entities currently in the group," the company said, noting that Westfield America Inc was set for a New York listing.

"To free up more of the chairman's time for these tasks, the group will adopt a new top management structure that divides Westfield's businesses into three areas, each headed by a managing director..."
Westfield also said fashion designer Carla Zampatti would join the board as a non-executive director.
